comments.text: Let me explain as Disney expert, travel agent and former Disney Cast member.  Parking at Disney Springs is free, but it does offer free transportation via bus/boat to to all Disney resorts.  The issue is people I guess are parking at DS to bypass paying for parking at the parks.  The only way this can happen you would have to take a resort bus for ex to Disney Grand Floridan.  From the bus can hop on monorail and go to Epcot or Magic Kingdom.  Then the boat only goes to certain resorts, but the most popular is Disney French Quarter which the only New Orleans themed resort with Cajun food, live band, and authentic beignets.  Its really hard to sneak in a Disney Pool and they really crack down on the Beach Club which was the most popular one.  I normally stay at DS hotel and resort hop to shop or eat.  I can't really ride no more, but I do like to have fun.  Any questions just ask.
